pages.title: Decisions inbox
pages.description: Everything waiting on the company's owner (the CEO), by priority, with what each blocks, the options, the recommendation and links; and how many are open by kind.

pages.title: Board
pages.description: Findings, dead ends, hypotheses and decisions, grouped by area or by team, each with its evidence and what would show it wrong.

pages.title: Dashboard
pages.description: Mission, budget lines (approved, spent, live; in dollars or tokens), spend over time and by member, milestones and KPIs.

pages.title: Knowledge
pages.description: Documents (ADR, EDD, TDD, BRD, PRD, decisions, runbooks, research, experiments, minutes) with a reader, and lessons by company or team scope.

pages.title: Meetings
pages.description: Every meeting: room, chair, participants, summary, decisions, objections, and the record it wrote.

pages.title: Notes
pages.description: The members' messages, by hour, as a record.

pages.title: Org
pages.description: The org tree from the org tool: collapsible, the chain of command to the top for anyone, links, and org changes from the log.

pages.title: Overview
pages.description: The company at a glance: links, mission, what waits on the CEO, its numbers, members and latest activity.

pages.title: People
pages.description: A directory of everyone in the org (name, title, team, where they sit, who they report to), searchable by team, with each person's last activity from the event log.

pages.title: Rooms
pages.description: The building: fixed floors and rooms, people at their desks, in meetings (with who is in them) or in the garden; replay with the activity beside it.
